versions.content: Routing Activation Failure Security Event Status: DRAFT If DoIPEnableSecurityEventReporting is enabled and SEV_DOIP_- ROUTING_ACTIVATION_CHECK_FAILED exists, the DoIP module shall report the security event SEV_DOIP_ROUTING_ACTIVATION_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM with the context data specified in [SWS_DoIP_00512] when a routing activation request is rejected due to a failure in "Routing activation checks" These checks include: • Unknown source address • All concurrently supported sockets are registered and active • Source address (SA) received differs from the one already activated on the socket • Source address (SA) received is already registered and active on a different socket • Missing authentication • Rejected confirmation • Activation type requires a secure socket
